# openxml-report-writer

> Write Excel xlsx reports from typed templates with hand-written SpreadsheetML: shared strings, number formats, row formulas, totals and byte-identical output NuGet package `Trysac.OpenxmlReportWriter`, namespace `Trysac.OpenxmlReportWriter`, MIT
> licensed, .NET >= 10, base class library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
